blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: An abstract data type is defined by its operations, not its memory layout. Callers use the interface. The implementation can change without breaking them.

blocks.title: Which order?
items: Array: items by index, fixed size

blocks.title: Grow a dynamic array

blocks.body: Check for empty before pop or dequeue, and for full before push or enqueue. Free what you malloc.
